paite: Israel mnaupang a hihlaiin, huailaiin amah ka ita, Aigupta akipan ka tapa ka sam khia.
english: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

paite: Amaute a sap bang un, huchiin amau akipan a pai uh: Baalin kiangah a kithoih ua, lim gelhte kiangah gimlim a hal hi.
english: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

paite: Hinapiin Ephraim pai ka kisinsaka; ka banin amau ka poma; himahleh amau ka hihdam chih a theikei uh.
english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by his arms; but they didn’t know that I healed them.

paite: Mihing khaujentein leh, itna guitein amau ka kaia; amau adin a muk tung uleh a muk nuai ua kipana hakkol lakkhiaksakte bang ka hia, a ma uah an ka lui hi.
english: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

paite: Aigupta gamah a kik nawn kei dinga; himahleh Assuria mi a kumpipa ahi ding, kik nawn a nial jiak un.
english: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

paite: Huan, a khopite tungah namsau likin a om dia, a siktawnte a hulin, a negai ding, a thuhilhte uh ngei jiakin.
english: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

paite: Huchiin ka miten kei akipan nungtawn a tum chiltel uh; a mah tung sanga ompa sam mahle uh, kuamah mahin amah a liansak kei ding uh.
english: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

paite: Ephraim, bangchiin ka hontawpsan dia? Israel, bangchiin kon tankhe dia? Admah bangin bangchiin ka honbawl dia? Zeboim bangin bangchiin ka honkoih dia? ka sungah ka lungtang a kilumleta, ka lainatnate toh a kuang khawm hi.
english: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

paite: Ka heh mahmahna ka suakkhe sak kei dinga, Ephraim hih se dingin ka kihei kei ding: mihing hi louin, Pathian lah ka hi ngala, nang laka Mi siangthou: khopi sungah ka lut kei ding.
english: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of you; and I will not come in wrath.

paite: Humpinelkai banga humham ding, TOUPA deihdanin a om ding ua; humham ding lah ahi ngala, huchiin tumlam akipan tate lingkawmin a hongpai ding uh.
english: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

paite: Aigupta akipana vasa bangin lingkhawmin a hongpai ding ua, Assuria gam akipana vakhu bangin: huan a inte ua teng dingin amau ka bawl ding. TOUPAN a chi.Ephraimin juauthuin kei a honum suaka, Israel inkuan khemnain: himahleh Judain Pathian toh vaia hawm laia, Mi Siangthou lakah a ginom lai hi.
english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ephraimin juauthuin kei a honum suaka, Israel inkuan khemnain: himahleh Judain Pathian toh vaia hawm laia, Mi Siangthou lakah a ginom lai hi.
english: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.
